summary: Six-layer text overlay renderer. Each layer fills a shared 64-byte stack buffer via a distinct string-builder sub-function (sub_49C6D0, sub_49BB40, sub_49BBB0, sub_49BCD0, sub_49BD40, sub_49C0B0) and immediately renders it with UITextRenderWithScale at a screen position derived from the a1 base offset. The first layer renders at (a1+50, 46) in red at scale 0.75; the remaining five render at (a1+245, 10/50/90) alternating white (0xFFFFFF) and red (16776960) at scale 1.0. The last render's result is returned. Structural twin of DrawDebugTextOverlay (004dbb60) per the prelabel.

operations.description: sub_49C6D0(v2, 64): fill the 64-byte string buffer with the first layer's text.
UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1+50, 46, red 16776960, alignment 2, style 0, scale 0.75, 1.0): render layer 1.
sub_49BB40(v2, 64): fill the buffer with layer 2 text.
UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1+245, 10, white 0xFFFFFF, alignment 1, style 2, scale 1.0, 1.0): render layer 2.
sub_49BBB0(v2, 64): fill the buffer with layer 3 text.
UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1+245, 10, red 16776960, alignment 0, style 1, scale 1.0, 1.0): render layer 3.
sub_49BCD0(v2, 64): fill the buffer with layer 4 text.
UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1+245, 50, white 0xFFFFFF, alignment 1, style 2, scale 1.0, 1.0): render layer 4.
sub_49BD40(v2, 64): fill the buffer with layer 5 text.
UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1+245, 50, red 16776960, alignment 0, style 1, scale 1.0, 1.0): render layer 5.
sub_49C0B0(v2, 64): fill the buffer with layer 6 text.
UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1+245, 90, red 16776960, alignment 0, style 1, scale 1.0, 1.0): render layer 6; its result is the function return value.
Return the result of the final UITextRenderWithScale call.
